t3: Explore local file transfers, two-way clipboard sharing, and copied text across networks.
t10: Drop a photo, video or file into WinSend on Windows. Your iPhone receives it directly over local Wi-Fi, ready to save or open.
t18: Copy a checklist, link or paragraph on Windows, fetch it in the WinSend app, then paste it anywhere on iPhone.
t25: Set up a WinSend Shortcut first. Then run it to send copied text to your Windows clipboard, without opening WinSend.
t34: When office, school, or public Wi-Fi blocks local connections, switch to Cloud and keep sharing clipboard text between iPhone and Windows.
t40: Install WinSend on both Windows and iPhone. Use your local network for files, or set up cloud clipboard for text across networks.
t44: File transfer from Windows to iPhone
t45: Clipboard transfer from Windows to iPhone
t46: Clipboard transfer from iPhone to Windows using Shortcuts
t47: Cloud clipboard transfer between Windows and iPhone
